title: Basic Modal Verbs (can, can't) - Ability and permission only

options.answer: I can to swim very well.

explanation.en: After 'can', we use the base form of the verb without 'to'.
explanation.ru: После 'can' используется начальная форма глагола без 'to'.
explanation.uz: 'can'dan keyin fe’lning 'to'siz asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: After 'can't', we use the base form of the verb.
explanation.ru: После 'can't' используется начальная форма глагола.
explanation.uz: 'can't'dan keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: Questions with 'can' start with 'Can' followed by the subject.
explanation.ru: Вопросы с 'can' начинаются с 'Can', затем идёт подлежащее.
explanation.uz: 'can' bilan savollar 'Can' bilan boshlanadi va undan so‘ng ega keladi.

explanation.en: The negative form of 'can' is 'can't' or 'cannot'.
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма 'can' — 'can't' или 'cannot'.
explanation.uz: 'can' ning inkor shakli — 'can't' yoki 'cannot'.

explanation.en: Use 'can't' + base form of the verb for negative sentences.
explanation.ru: Для отрицательных предложений используйте 'can't' + начальную форму глагола.
explanation.uz: Inkor gaplarda 'can't' + fe’lning asosiy shaklini ishlating.

explanation.en: In questions, 'can' comes before the subject and the main verb is in base form.
explanation.ru: В вопросах 'can' стоит перед подлежащим, а смысловой глагол — в начальной форме.
explanation.uz: Savollarda 'can' ega oldidan keladi va asosiy fe’l asosiy shaklda bo‘ladi.

options.answer: You can to open the window.

explanation.en: Use 'can' + base form when giving permission.
explanation.ru: Для разрешения используйте 'can' + начальную форму глагола.

explanation.en: After 'can't', always use the base form of the verb.
explanation.ru: После 'can't' всегда используется начальная форма глагола.
explanation.uz: 'can't'dan keyin har doim fe’lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with 'can' or 'can't'

items.text: My name is Sarah and I want to tell you about my family's abilities. My father ___1___ drive a car very well, but he ___2___ ride a bicycle. My mother is amazing - she ___3___ cook delicious food and she ___4___ speak three languages: English, French, and Spanish. However, she ___5___ swim because she is afraid of water. My little brother Tom is only five years old, so he ___6___ read books yet, but he ___7___ draw beautiful pictures. He loves art! I am fifteen and I ___8___ play the guitar and sing. My friends say I ___9___ sing very well. Unfortunately, I ___10___ dance at all - I always step on people's feet! My grandmother lives with us and even though she is seventy, she ___11___ use a computer and send emails. She ___12___ also knit warm sweaters for the whole family. What about sports? Well, I ___13___ play tennis but I ___14___ play football. My brother ___15___ run very fast for his age.

explanation.en: Use 'can' for abilities people have and 'can't' for abilities they don't have.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'can' для способностей, которые у людей есть, и 'can't' — для тех, которых нет.
explanation.uz: Odamlarda mavjud qobiliyatlar uchun 'can', mavjud bo‘lmaganlari uchun 'can't' ishlating.

items.text: Anna: Hi Mike! ___1___ you help me with my homework? Mike: Of course! What subject is it? Anna: It's math. I ___2___ understand this problem at all. Mike: Let me see. Oh, this is easy! You ___3___ solve it like this. First, you add these numbers. Anna: ___4___ you show me step by step? Mike: Sure! Look, you ___5___ use this formula here. Anna: I think I understand now, but I ___6___ remember the formula. ___7___ you write it down for me? Mike: No problem. Here it is. Now, ___8___ you try the next problem yourself? Anna: I think so. Let me see... Yes! I ___9___ do it now! Mike: Great! You ___10___ learn this very quickly. Anna: Thank you so much! ___11___ I ask you for help again tomorrow? Mike: Of course! I ___12___ meet you in the library after school. Anna: Perfect! And maybe you ___13___ help me with science too? I ___14___ understand chemistry at all. Mike: Sure, but I ___15___ help you with physics because I'm not good at it.

explanation.en: Use 'Can' for questions, 'can' for positive statements, and 'can't' for negative statements.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'Can' для вопросов, 'can' — для утвердительных предложений, а 'can't' — для отрицательных.
explanation.uz: Savollar uchun 'Can', ijobiy gaplar uchun 'can', inkor gaplar uchun 'can't' ishlating.

items.text: Welcome to our English class! Here are some important things you need to know. Students ___1___ bring their books to every lesson - this is very important. You ___2___ also bring a notebook and a pen. During the lesson, you ___3___ ask questions if you don't understand something. However, you ___4___ use your mobile phone during class - please turn it off. If you need to leave the room, you ___5___ ask for permission first. You ___6___ say 'Can I go to the bathroom?' or 'Can I get some water?' Now, let me tell you about our classroom activities. Some students ___7___ speak English very well already, but others ___8___ speak much yet. Don't worry if you ___9___ understand everything immediately. You ___10___ practice at home with the exercises I give you. All students ___11___ borrow books from our class library. You ___12___ also use the computers during break time, but you ___13___ play games on them - they are for studying only. Remember, you ___14___ always ask me for help if you need it. I ___15___ help you during class or after school.

explanation.en: Use 'can' for permissions and abilities, 'can't' for restrictions and lack of ability.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'can' для разрешений и способностей, 'can't' — для запретов и отсутствия способности.
explanation.uz: Ruxsat va qobiliyatlar uchun 'can', cheklov va qobiliyat yo‘qligi uchun 'can't' ishlating.

items.text: I love animals and I want to tell you about different pets and what they ___1___ do. Dogs are amazing pets because they ___2___ learn many tricks. They ___3___ sit, stay, and come when you call them. Most dogs ___4___ also swim, but some dogs ___5___ swim because they are afraid of water. Cats are very independent animals. They ___6___ climb trees very well and they ___7___ see in the dark. However, most cats ___8___ swim - they don't like water at all! Birds are fascinating pets. Parrots ___9___ talk and repeat words, and some ___10___ even sing songs. Small birds like canaries ___11___ fly around the house, but you ___12___ let them outside because they might get lost. Fish are quiet pets that ___13___ swim all day in their tank. They ___14___ make any noise, which is perfect for apartments. However, fish ___15___ live outside their water tank - they need water to breathe.

explanation.en: Use 'can' for natural abilities and 'can't' for things animals cannot do.
